title: Users
description: The accounts of this panel. Admins manage everything, managers every site, users only the sites you grant.

roles.adminHint: Everything, including accounts and server settings.
roles.managerHint: Every site, but not the server or the accounts.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: The new account gets a one-time link to set its password.
invite.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
invite.emailHint: The link is sent there, and the address becomes the account's once the link is used. Needs email set up.

link.title: Invitation for {{name}}
link.emailedHint: If it does not arrive, send the link below yourself.
link.text: Send this link to {{name}} on a channel you trust. It works once, expires <time/> and is shown only now.
link.label: Invitation link
link.copyFailed: Copying is not possible here. Select the link and copy it by hand.

policy.title: Second factor
policy.require: Require a second factor for every account
policy.hint: Admins and managers always need TOTP or a passkey. With this on, users need one too, whatever is set for the single account. Without one, an account is led to set it up right after logging in and can do nothing else until then; its API tokens stop working.
policy.without_one: 1 account has no second factor yet
policy.without_other: {{count}} accounts have no second factor yet
policy.withoutText: They can still log in, but only to set one up. Their API tokens answer “second factor required” until then.
policy.on: Every account now needs a second factor.
policy.off: A second factor is optional again for users.

account.title: User {{name}}
account.selfText: Change your password and second factor under Settings. Another admin changes your role.
account.requiredForAll: Required for every account. Turn it off under Users, Second factor.
account.secondFactorRequired: A second factor is now required.
account.secondFactorOptional: A second factor is now optional.
account.resetText: This removes the password and every second factor and makes a new invitation link. Its sessions end.
account.disabledText: This account is disabled and cannot log in. Its API tokens do not work.
account.disableText: Disabling ends its sessions and stops its API tokens until you enable it again.
account.deleteText: The account and its API tokens are gone for good.

errors.own_account: You cannot change, reset or delete your own account here.
errors.last_admin: This is the last enabled admin. Make another account admin first.
errors.not_grantee: Admins and managers reach every site; only users get site grants.
errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation link is invalid, used or expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.not_found: This account does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.second_factor_required: Set up a second factor for your own account first (Settings).
errors.mail_not_configured: Email is not set up (Administration, Email). Leave the address empty and pass the link on yourself.
